items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: a bass player named, uh, Stuart Davis, myself on guitar

ctx.x: Yeah. We played, uh, well, he was already working as the piano, so they decided to have put two more pieces, a bass player named, uh, Stuart Davis, myself on guitar, and we stayed there, I'd say about three years.
What kind of stuff were you playing then?
